notes.title: Playtest Patch 1
notes.content:
Changes based on playtester feedback:

Changed:
- Credit Module text spacing improved
- Improved clarity of some relic descriptions
- Improved clarity of Scrapper crew member
- Reroll button highlighted when hovered over
- Pressing “Enter” allows you to also end the level
Fixed:
- Added weapon sound to poison dart
- Added sounds when mousing over UI in hub area
